rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for rock containing valuable metals or other materials that is mined and processed.

example.english: This ore has to be sent to a smelter for processing.
example.traditional: 呢啲礦石要送去冶煉廠提煉。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 kong3 sek6 jiu3 sung3 heoi3 je5 lin6 cong2 tai4 lin6
